messages:
Nadine (People Ops): Uploaded a new handbook addendum: 'Data Protection & Personal Info Handling'  covers minimal retention for interview notes, consent language for recorded calls, and a manager ack flow. Need quick alignment on rollout.

Carlos (Eng Lead): Quick question: does this change how we store candidate CVs in the recruiting bucket?

Nadine (People Ops): Yes, recommends move to 90-day retention by default unless candidate opts in; Hiring Ops to run archival job. Also added sample consent text for recorded interviews.

Priyanka (HR-Intl): For APAC/EU I added localized consent snippets and link to region-specific DPA clauses. See appendix.

Aaron (Hiring Ops): I can export manager list and generate per-manager ack links. Propose two waves: Wave 1 = hiring managers + people managers; Wave 2 = all other managers. Reminder cadence: day 0, day 4, day 9. Target completion: 12 business days.

Nadine (People Ops): Good. Make ack require: watch 12-min microtraining + complete 6-question quiz. Managers must confirm their team-level practices updated within 2 weeks.

Carlos (Eng Lead): Can the acknowledgment automatically mark the Recruiting tracker? Saves manual sync.

Aaron (Hiring Ops): Yep, will webhook to the People Ops tracker and attach CSV export to the People Ops drive. I'll param manager_id in the links so the ack page shows their direct reports.

policy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook addendum: Data Protection  Manager ack due in 12d"  sending wave 1 in 15 minutes.

Nadine (People Ops): Manager checklist (short) added to the doc:

```
Manager checklist:
- Ensure candidate docs older than 90 days are archived unless opted-in
- Use standard consent language for call recordings
- Complete handbook ack + quiz within 12 business days
- Confirm team process updates in next 1:1
- Escalate any gov/regulatory conflicts to HR-Intl
```

Priyanka (HR-Intl): I'll record two microtraining times for EMEA/APAC and provide translated summaries for JP/FR/DE.

Nadine (People Ops): Final actions: Priyanka upload trainings by EOD Thu, Aaron schedule exports + reminders, Carlos compile any infra exceptions. I'll send company note after wave 1 reaches 65% ack.

Carlos (Eng Lead): Acknowledged, will DM edge cases now."
